[{"version":"20260908175624","name":"phase3_security_boundary_hardening","statements":["-- Phase 3 low-risk security hardening.\n-- Keep existing RLS policy semantics; tighten object execution and view behavior.\n\nALTER VIEW public.v_discipline_summary SET (security_invoker = true);\nALTER VIEW public.v_player_profiles SET (security_invoker = true);\nALTER VIEW public.v_active_suspensions SET (security_invoker = true);\nALTER VIEW public.v_standings SET (security_invoker = true);\nALTER VIEW public.v_top_scorers SET (security_invoker = true);\n\nALTER FUNCTION public.update_updated_at() SET search_path = public, pg_temp;\n\n-- The client-facing API should not grant anonymous write capabilities at the table level.\n-- Existing public SELECT policies remain unchanged.\nREVOKE INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE, TRUNCATE, REFERENCES, TRIGGER ON TABLE\n  public.profiles,\n  public.players,\n  public.clubs,\n  public.coaches,\n  public.referees,\n  public.fixtures,\n  public.match_results,\n  public.player_match_stats,\n  public.disciplinary_records,\n  public.suspensions,\n  public.standings\nFROM anon;\n\n-- These tables are public-readable by policy, but writes must remain authenticated and policy-gated.\nGRANT INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE, TRUNCATE, REFERENCES, TRIGGER ON TABLE\n  public.profiles,\n  public.players,\n  public.clubs,\n  public.coaches,\n  public.referees,\n  public.fixtures,\n  public.match_results,\n  public.player_match_stats,\n  public.disciplinary_records,\n  public.suspensions,\n  public.standings\nTO authenticated;"]},{"version":"20260908182106","name":"phase3_match_stat_reconciliation_contract","statements":["-- Phase 3: Match Stat reconciliation contract\n-- Documentation/guardrail migration only. No live-event tables or RPCs are introduced here.\n-- Explicitly harden the legacy standings trigger against repeated official-result updates.\n\nCREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.update_standings_on_official_result()\nRETURNS trigger\nLANGUAGE plpgsql\nSECURITY DEFINER\nSET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE\n  v_league_id UUID;\n  v_home_id UUID;\n  v_away_id UUID;\n  v_home_goals INTEGER;\n  v_away_goals INTEGER;\nBEGIN\n  -- Legacy compatibility path: standings are updated only once, when a result\n  -- becomes official. Subsequent UPDATEs to an already-official result must not\n  -- increment standings again.\n  IF (TG_OP = 'UPDATE' AND OLD.is_official = false AND NEW.is_official = true)\n     OR (TG_OP = 'INSERT' AND NEW.is_official = true) THEN\n    SELECT league_id, home_club_id, away_club_id\n      INTO v_league_id, v_home_id, v_away_id\n    FROM public.fixtures\n    WHERE id = NEW.fixture_id;\n\n    IF v_league_id IS NULL OR v_home_id IS NULL OR v_away_id IS NULL THEN\n      RAISE EXCEPTION 'Cannot update standings: fixture % is incomplete or missing', NEW.fixture_id;\n    END IF;\n\n    v_home_goals := NEW.home_goals;\n    v_away_goals := NEW.away_goals;\n\n    INSERT INTO public.standings (league_id, club_id)\n    VALUES (v_league_id, v_home_id)\n    ON CONFLICT (league_id, club_id) DO NOTHING;\n\n    INSERT INTO public.standings (league_id, club_id)\n    VALUES (v_league_id, v_away_id)\n    ON CONFLICT (league_id, club_id) DO NOTHING;\n\n    UPDATE public.standings\n    SET played = played + 1,\n        wins = wins + CASE WHEN v_home_goals > v_away_goals THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,\n        draws = draws + CASE WHEN v_home_goals = v_away_goals THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,\n        losses = losses + CASE WHEN v_home_goals < v_away_goals THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,\n        goals_for = goals_for + v_home_goals,\n        goals_against = goals_against + v_away_goals,\n        goal_difference = (goals_for + v_home_goals) - (goals_against + v_away_goals),\n        points = points + CASE\n          WHEN v_home_goals > v_away_goals THEN 3\n          WHEN v_home_goals = v_away_goals THEN 1\n          ELSE 0\n        END,\n        updated_at = NOW()\n    WHERE league_id = v_league_id AND club_id = v_home_id;\n\n    UPDATE public.standings\n    SET played = played + 1,\n        wins = wins + CASE WHEN v_away_goals > v_home_goals THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,\n        draws = draws + CASE WHEN v_away_goals = v_home_goals THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,\n        losses = losses + CASE WHEN v_away_goals < v_home_goals THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,\n        goals_for = goals_for + v_away_goals,\n        goals_against = goals_against + v_home_goals,\n        goal_difference = (goals_for + v_away_goals) - (goals_against + v_home_goals),\n        points = points + CASE\n          WHEN v_away_goals > v_home_goals THEN 3\n          WHEN v_away_goals = v_home_goals THEN 1\n          ELSE 0\n        END,\n
